list.heading: FTPS logins
list.subtitle: Logins that reach one account's files over FTPS.
list.prefixNote: FTPS logins are separate users from SFTP logins on this server. Every login carries the owning account's name as a prefix, and the names below are exactly what the server holds — sign in with them as they are.
list.emptyDescription: Create the first login above. Its password is shown once, when it is created.
list.noResultsDescription: Change the search or the filter, or clear them to see every FTPS login.
list.confirmResetPassword: Set a new password? The current one stops working immediately.
list.confirmRemove: Remove this login? The account's files stay where they are, but nobody can sign in with this name again.

form.heading: New FTPS login
form.hint: Lowercase letters and digits only. The account's name is added in front of it.
form.ftpsOffNote: FTPS is turned off on this server, so no FTPS login can be created yet. An administrator turns the service on; SFTP logins are unaffected.

errors.accountRequired: Choose the account that will own the login.
errors.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters and digits only, up to 30 characters.

credential.title: FTPS password
credential.warning: This password is shown once. Nothing keeps a copy of it — not this panel, not the server — so it cannot be shown again. Copy it before you close this.
credential.hostNote: Connect to this host name exactly as written. The server's certificate is issued for it, and a client pointed at any other name — including your own domain — will report a name mismatch.
credential.hostUndisclosed: This panel does not disclose the transfer host to your account. Ask your administrator which host name and port to connect to.
credential.selfSignedNote: The server's certificate is a placeholder the panel generated for itself. Clients will warn about it until a real certificate is issued for this host.
credential.resetHint: If it is lost, reset the password from the list. That is the only way back — there is nothing to recover.

server.heading: FTPS service
server.description: One daemon for the whole server. Everything below was measured on the host, not recalled from this panel's settings.

states.tlsForced: TLS required for logins and transfers

server.ipv4Only: This host has no IPv6 address, so the daemon is bound to IPv4 only.
server.selfSigned: The certificate is a placeholder this panel generated. Every client will warn until a real one is issued for this host name.

warnings.unreachable: The service is answering on this host, but no firewall rule lets its ports through. Nobody outside the server can connect.
warnings.lingering: FTPS is turned off and its ports are still open in the firewall. Stopping a service does not close a port.

agreement.runningButOff: The service is running although FTPS is turned off in the panel. Customers can still reach it; stop the service to match the setting.
agreement.onButNotRunning: FTPS is turned on in the panel, but the service is not running. Turning FTPS on again re-applies the configuration and starts it.
agreement.runningButNotAnswering: The service is running, but its control port gave no greeting on this host, so no client can be served.

form.note: Customers connect to this host name, because the server presents one certificate for the whole panel. Turning the service on does not open the firewall — that is offered separately, so a new listening port is never a surprise.
form.disableReasonNeverConfigured: FTPS has never been turned on on this server, and the service is not running.
form.disableReasonOff: FTPS is already turned off and the service is not running.

feedback.enabled: FTPS is turned on and answering on port {port}.
feedback.enabledNotRunning: FTPS is turned on, but the service is not running.
feedback.enabledNotAnswering: FTPS is turned on, but the service is not answering yet.
feedback.disabled: FTPS is turned off and the service is stopped.
feedback.disabledStillRunning: FTPS is turned off, but the service is still running.
feedback.unexpectedFailure: The request did not complete. Check that the panel is reachable and try again.
